title: Instant withdraw lets users self-fund residuals with their own penalty
summary: _Acknowledged_  ## Severity  **Impact:** Medium  **Likelihood:** Medium  ## Description  When a user calls `BobStaking::instantWithdraw`, the function first calls `_claimRewards(msg.sender, false)`. If `rewardTokenBalance` is insufficient, `_claimRewards` credits the shortfall to `residualRewardBalance[msg.sender]` (and may pay `rewardsToPay == 0`).
